name: TableOfContents
summary: In-page index of a document's sections. Sticky beside the content, marks the section in view.

props.name: items
props.description: The entries: {id, label, sub?}. `sub` indents one level and there is no level below that — a contents list that mirrors five heading levels is a second document.

props.name: current
props.description: The id of the section you are in; it gets aria-current. Which one that is depends on scroll, and scroll is the page's business, not the component's.

props.name: label
props.description: Both the visible heading and the accessible name of the <nav> — one string, so they cannot say different things.
